La Cucha is a food diary, not medical or nutrition advice. Goals are general estimates that don’t know your health, and food values are approximate. If you have an illness, are pregnant, or have or had an eating disorder, talk to a health professional. You use the app at your own risk.
Food values come from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy 2018 and FNDDS 2024), by the U.S. Department of Agriculture. They are in the public domain (CC0 1.0).
Scanned products come from Open Food Facts: the database is under the Open Database License (ODbL) and its contents under the Database Contents License (DbCL). It is only queried when scanning.
The barcode reader: ZXing and zxing-android-embedded. Apache License 2.0.

Your diary, goals, weight, recipes and products stay in this profile on the phone and, with your account, are saved there automatically, encrypted with your password: if you reinstall or change phones, they come back. Save a backup before removing a profile.
La Cucha’s network: your Fogón Social account, the same in every app. Follow other people and share dishes, recipes and restaurants.

Only what you choose to share appears on the network: never your goals, your weight or what you eat each day. Your diary is saved to your account encrypted with your password: nobody else can read it, not even Fogón. A dish’s or recipe’s calories and macros only go out if you include them. A restaurant’s location only goes out if you add it.
Fogón Social is paused until you accept the current policy. Nothing is shared. Your diary is still available.

Now, if notifications are on, they arrive right away: when you have something new, Google (Firebase) sends your phone an empty signal, with no text and no sender, and the app asks Fogón for the rest. We also now say how long content reported for putting a minor at risk is kept: one year, for the authorities.

One Fogón Social account for every app, with separate sessions. Name, photo, cover and bio are global. Only the dishes, recipes and reviews you choose are shared, with their visibility. Signing out other sessions and deleting the account affect every app.
Deleting your social account has a grace period and affects every app. Your local diary is kept until you remove the profile.
